text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in their DM. There are six Moss notes in the public share, and two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers come up in them:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and the next morning's shift got through fine.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). Barcode scanners at Door 14 couldn't read trailer tags, and the ticket was escalated to tier-2.

I warned Dana about one conflict. A note written by Marcus, not Moss, describes #4419 as a printer delay at Gate 3. From the two notes alone I can't tell which description is right.

The other ticket numbers in Moss's notes (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to Central team accounts, so I left them off. All of this came from public notes. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.
